```{r}

library(Seurat)

```


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(randomForest)
# Step 1: Prepare the Seurat Object
seurat_obj <- fibro.nmf
seurat_obj$sample <- seurat_obj$orig.ident
seurat_obj$condition <- ifelse(seurat_obj$Dx == "HC", "Control", "CTCL")
table(seurat_obj$condition, seurat_obj$sample)

# Step 2: Preprocess the Data
seurat_obj <- NormalizeData(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_obj)
seurat_obj <- ScaleData(seurat_obj)

# Step 3: Extract Sample Information
samples <- unique(seurat_obj$sample)
sample_labels <- seurat_obj@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  summarize(condition = first(condition)) %>% 
  pull(condition, name = sample)

# Step 4: Define Functions
compute_mean_expression <- function(seurat_obj, cells) {
  if (length(cells) == 0) {
    stop("No cells provided to compute_mean_expression")
  }
  expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data")[, cells, drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.matrix(expr_matrix) && !inherits(expr_matrix, "dgCMatrix") || ncol(expr_matrix) == 0) {
    stop("expr_matrix is not a valid matrix or has no columns")
  }
  means <- rowMeans(expr_matrix)
  names(means) <- rownames(expr_matrix)
  return(means)
}

bootstrap_mean_expression <- function(seurat_obj, sample, n_bootstraps = 10) {
  sample_cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, expression = sample == !!sample)
  n_cells <- length(sample_cells)
  if (n_cells == 0) {
    stop(paste("No cells found for sample:", sample))
  }
  bootstrap_means <- replicate(n_bootstraps, {
    bootstrap_idx <- sample(sample_cells, size = n_cells, replace = TRUE)
    compute_mean_expression(seurat_obj, bootstrap_idx)
  }, simplify = "matrix")  # Ensure output is a matrix
  rownames(bootstrap_means) <- rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data"))
  return(bootstrap_means)
}

# Step 5: Set Up Cross-Validation
set.seed(42)
kf <- createFolds(samples, k = 5, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE)

# Step 6: Train and Evaluate the Model
accuracies <- c()
n_bootstraps <- 10
n_genes <- nrow(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data"))  # Define number of genes

for (fold in kf) {
  train_samples <- samples[-fold]
  test_samples <- samples[fold]
  
  # Augment training data with bootstrap samples
  X_train <- matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = n_genes)  # Initialize with correct columns
  y_train <- c()
  for (sample in train_samples) {
    bootstrap_means <- bootstrap_mean_expression(seurat_obj, sample, n_bootstraps)
    label <- sample_labels[sample]
    bootstrap_means <- t(bootstrap_means)  # Transpose: samples as rows, genes as columns
    X_train <- rbind(X_train, bootstrap_means)
    y_train <- c(y_train, rep(label, n_bootstraps))
  }
  colnames(X_train) <- rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data"))
  y_train <- factor(y_train)
  
  # Test data using true mean expression vectors
  X_test <- sapply(test_samples, function(sample) {
    sample_cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, expression = sample == !!sample)
    compute_mean_expression(seurat_obj, sample_cells)
  })
  X_test <- t(X_test)
  colnames(X_test) <- rownames(GetAssayData(seurat_obj, slot = "data"))
  y_test <- sample_labels[test_samples]
  
  # Train Random Forest model
  model <- train(X_train, y_train, method = "rf", trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5))
  
  # Predict and evaluate
  y_pred <- predict(model, X_test)
  accuracy <- confusionMatrix(y_pred, factor(y_test))$overall["Accuracy"]
  accuracies <- c(accuracies, accuracy)
}

# Step 7: Report average accuracy
mean_accuracy <- mean(accuracies)
print(paste("Average accuracy:", round(mean_accuracy, 2)))

```







```{r}
importance <- varImp(model, scale = FALSE)$importance
importance_df <- data.frame(
  Gene = rownames(importance),
  Importance = importance$Overall
) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>% 
  top_n(20, Importance)  # Select top 20 genes for clarity

# Plot feature importance
ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Gene, Importance), y = Importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "forestgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Most Important Genes in Random Forest Model",
       x = "Gene",
       y = "Mean Decrease in Gini") +
  theme_minimal()
```
